memory.description: Cross-session memory startup, fallible recall, candidate observations with trigger context, and explicit consolidation maintenance. Applies independently alongside task-specific packs.
memory.applies_to: all primary sessions; prior context; durable notes; handoff maintenance

implementation.description: Production code, executable configuration, scripts, dependencies, bug fixes, and implementation review. Not for prose-only changes.
implementation.applies_to: production code/config/scripts; implementation or bug-fix work

testing.description: Every production behavior change, bug fix, risky refactor, public contract change, migration, concurrency change, or test edit.
testing.applies_to: behavior changes, bugs, tests, contracts, migrations, concurrency

architecture.description: Cross-module or subsystem design, public interfaces, domain models, new modules, deep-module work, broad refactors, abstractions, or load-bearing performance.

python.description: Python source, packaging, pyproject or lock files, Python tests, typing, linting, or uv-based commands.

git.description: Git mutation, staging, commits, history changes, deletion or restoration, publication, diff review, or multi-actor worktree coordination.

docs.description: Markdown, READMEs, setup or run instructions, durable docs, comments, docstrings, CLI help, or prose source-of-truth changes.

data-safety.description: Schemas, migrations, backfills, transactions, durable state, serialization or wire formats, caches across deploys, or compatibility that can lose or reinterpret data.

concurrency.description: Async tasks, threads, processes, locks, queues, workers, schedulers, cancellation, shared state, parallelism, or distributed coordination.
